text:
Waiting 14 minutes for a build is a drag on the whole day, so we moved from Jenkins to GitHub Actions. Builds now take 6 minutes, less than half the time. Our monthly CI bill dropped from $900 to $410.

The migration took three weeks. We moved 41 pipelines and rebuilt each workflow to use GitHub's native integrations instead of porting the Jenkins setup over as it was.

This post covers why we switched and what we learned. It should be useful if you're a platform engineer, a backend developer, or anyone who wants code to ship faster. You'll have time to finish your coffee now.
